name: valid-blog
description: The blog manifest with a note, an article and an announcement. It passes.

name: valid-firm
description: The firm manifest, rebuilt at the seq the site built last. It passes.

name: lower-seq
description: The site already built a higher seq.

name: bad-signature
description: The .sig is a valid signature by the right key over other bytes.

name: manifest-bytes-changed
description: The manifest at its address says seq 7. Its bytes no longer hash to the address.

name: blob-bytes-changed
description: The article HTML at its address names Brahe. Its bytes no longer hash to the address.

name: wrong-target
description: The signed firm manifest, served at a blog address and dispatched to the blog.

name: approval-mismatch
description: A signed manifest whose note claims an approval hash the Document does not give.

name: html-script
description: A signed manifest whose article HTML blob holds a script element. The blob hash is right.

name: dot-segment-path
description: A signed manifest whose note path has a segment that starts with a dot.

name: entry-path-is-attachment-path
description: A signed manifest whose announcement sits at the path of the article attachment.

name: redirect-conflict
description: A signed manifest whose note claims the former path of a tombstone as its legacyUrl.

name: html-attachment-path
description: A signed manifest that serves the article image at a path ending in .html.
